title: Prosperity after disaster? The effects of the Gothic invasion in Athens and Corinth
containerTitle: Production and Prosperity in the Theodosian Period: Proceedings of ROCT 2010, 69–89
bibliographicNote: Chapter 2. Pages 69–73 compare written accounts of the 396 invasion and their authors. Later sections test claims of destruction against the archaeological record in Athens and Corinth. University of Edinburgh Research Explorer also lists the publication.
